description: This file defines the PHP class I18NGroupSearchFilterParams within the OrangeHRM Admin module. It extends a base FilterParams class and specifies allowed sort fields related to internationalization (i18n) group search filtering.

classes.name: I18NGroupSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object for specifying search filter parameters for internationalization (i18n) groups, including allowed sort fields.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of I18NGroupSearchFilterParams and sets the default sort field to null.
